description.text: Remarks This program is avalaible for general Scholars as advanced studies. General Scholars for advanced studies must complete relevant courses and programs in one year and will receive an advanced studies certificate. Main research fields and directions 1.Health monitoring reinforcing technology and new materials application for bridge structural 2.Optical, electric testing technology and numerical simulation for the bridge and tunnel structures. 3.Dynamic coupling analysis for high speed railway bridge Features The graduate program of the discipline is high quality and well designed to delicately prepare the students for future engineering careers. Over years, the discipline has successfully formed its distinguished features in the field of bridge structural analysis, structural design principles and testing evaluation, and technological transformation method for old and ancient bridges.

duration.text: The Bridge and Tunnel Engineering at Huazhong University of Science and Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5277 USD/per year ￥ 38000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Undergraduate certificate Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English. If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of Undergraduate school 5. English proficiency test certificate For example, IELTS or TOEFL, only for applicant whose native language is not English. 6. Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1. Have obtained Bachelor's Degree 2. Be in good health 3. Be under the age of 45 4. Good command of English
